title: Config UI: Pump unreachable threshold displays in the wrong location
body:
In Preferences > Local Alerts > Advanced , there is an 'Alert if pump is unreachable' toggle. It has a corresponding setting 'Pump unreachable threshold [min]' but that's displayed below another setting instead of adjacent to the corresponding toggle setting
![Local-alerts-misplaced-config-entry](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/34991028/142776318-a0512ea0-eaf3-4090-8025-cc2d63c4f063.png)
.
